Prop List and Specs

One row per prop type in the palette — same numbers as the Prop Inventory tab. Total pixels = pixels per segment × number of segments. Watts/px @ max defaults to the standard WS2811 full‑white spec (0.36 W/px @ 12V, 0.30 W/px @ 5V) — adjust per row if a prop uses different pixels. Every placed prop of that type uses these.

Port summary

Every physical port on every placed board, one row each — matches the Port Summary tab of your old F16v5 workbook. Ports fill in wiring order; unused ports show at the bottom, and anything past a board’s port count shows as not assigned.

Power budget summary

Totals across every prop placed on the map, regardless of wiring — matches the Power Budget Summary on the Prop Inventory tab.

Port & PSU budget check

Output ports needed are counted at device-to-prop connections only. Daisy-chained props share the first output; props with multiple ports count each required port. Ethernet links between controllers and receivers do not count as pixel outputs. Amp limits are planning assumptions and must be checked against the exact hardware, fuse, PSU, wiring, and pixel specifications.

Electrical assumptions

Planning values used by the electrical estimates. The 3 A per-port value is a conservative editable planning threshold, not a verified published rating for every F16v5, SRx1, or ESP32 output. Manufacturer product pages confirm resettable electronic fuses on F16v5/SRx1 but do not state a numeric per-output current rating. Verify the exact board revision/manual and fuse behavior before relying on a limit.
